You are a code-feature worker (test-first) implementing ONE bash script for the loop-stack board pipeline.
Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the loop-stack-session repo (branch i52-obsidian-board-mvp); edit files here directly. Do not push. Do NOT git commit at any point; leave every change uncommitted in the worktree (the harness exports your diff and the orchestrator applies and commits it).

You own ONLY this path; do not create, edit, or delete anything else:
- Create: scripts/board-cards.sh

The acceptance check tests/board/cards.sh is FIXED and AUTHORITATIVE; the harness overwrites any copy with the canonical test and runs it. Do not edit it. It is reproduced verbatim at the end of this spec so you can develop test-first.

PORTABILITY (hard constraint): macOS stock /bin/bash 3.2. No associative arrays, no ${var,,}, no grep -P, no GNU-only flags. `set -uo pipefail`.

GOAL: scripts/board-cards.sh reads the Discovery TSV on stdin and joins tracker + git signals into a Card TSV on stdout.

CONSUMES: the Discovery TSV on stdin (9 fields, the upstream contract). Tracker issues via a command indirection TRACKER_CMD (default scripts/tracker.sh) so tests inject a stub. For each conforming, included repo run `( cd <repo_path> && "$TRACKER_CMD" list )`, which emits the JSON array [{number, title, labels:[{name}], updatedAt}]. Parse it with the repo's no-jq brace-scan pattern (as used in scripts/tracker.sh next-eligible and scripts/gen-mirrors.sh); do NOT add a jq dependency.

Card TSV (tab-separated, one row per card, NO header, exactly 12 fields, this order):
1  card_id         stable id: <repo_key>#<token> for tracker cards, <repo_key>#git for git
2  repo_key        owning repo, as in the Discovery TSV
3  source          tracker or git
4  column          one of the eight columns (below)
5  title           card title (issue title, or "<repo_key> working tree" for git cards)
6  token           doc-grammar token: I<n> or B<n> for tracker cards, empty for git cards
7  staleness_band  1..4 (below)
8  last_work_date  YYYY-MM-DD: issue updatedAt for tracker cards, commit date for git
9  local_position  e.g. "3 uncommitted, +2 ahead", or "clean", or empty for pure tracker cards
10 behind_note     e.g. "1 behind as of 2026-09-01 14:00", or empty
11 health          ok, degraded, or failed
12 render_epoch    unix seconds of this render (captured once at start, stamped on every row)

THE EIGHT COLUMNS (kanban order): backlog, next-up, in-session, blocked-on-you, blocked-on-fact, awaiting-review, handed-off, done.

COLUMN ASSIGNMENT (tracker issues):
- idea label            -> backlog  (token B<n>)
- agent:todo / no agent: label -> next-up (token I<n>)
- agent:working         -> in-session
- agent:needs-input     -> blocked-on-you
- agent:review          -> awaiting-review
- wayfinder:* labels    -> SKIP the issue entirely (no card)
- done / blocked-on-fact / handed-off receive NO tracker cards in the MVP.

STALENESS BANDS from last_work_date age against the render date: <5 -> 1, <15 -> 2, <30 -> 3, else 4.
Tracker card last_work_date = the date of the issue updatedAt; git card last_work_date = the date of last_commit_epoch (field 6 of Discovery TSV).

TOKEN: B<number> when the issue carries the idea label, else I<number>.

FREE-TEXT SAFETY: every free-text field (title, local_position, behind_note) passes through `tr '\t\n' '  '` (tabs and newlines to spaces) BEFORE it is written into a row, so a tab or newline in an issue title can never shift or split a row.

FAILED TRACKER SOURCE (health model): on a non-zero tracker exit for a conforming repo, emit exactly ONE card: card_id=<repo_key>#tracker, source=tracker, column=next-up, title="<repo_key> tracker unavailable", health=failed. Never zero cards, never many.

GIT CARD RULE: the git source emits one standalone card (source=git, column=next-up, card_id=<repo_key>#git, token empty, title="<repo_key> working tree") for every included repo EXCEPT a conforming repo that is clean (zero uncommitted, ahead 0 or -1) AND already has at least one tracker card, where the git card is SUPPRESSED. Non-conforming repos, dirty repos, and repos with no tracker cards always get a git card.
- local_position composed from uncommitted/ahead: "clean" when uncommitted is 0 and ahead is 0 or -1; when ahead is -1 and uncommitted>0, show only the uncommitted clause, never "+-1 ahead"; otherwise e.g. "3 uncommitted, +2 ahead".
- behind_note from behind_fetch (field 9), formatted "<n> behind as of <YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM>", else empty.
- git card health = degraded when the repo is non-conforming, else ok.

NEGATIVE JOIN: no git-to-tracker merge in the MVP; card_id embeds repo_key, so issue 52 in two repos yields two distinct ids. Every discovered included repo yields at least one card (git-card suppression only when it already has a tracker card and is clean+conforming).

HOW TO RUN (from worktree root): `bash tests/board/cards.sh` must exit 0.
OUTPUT CONTRACT: scripts/board-cards.sh only; leave it uncommitted for patch export.
If anything is ambiguous, take the most conservative reading consistent with the acceptance test and note it at the end of your final message.

--- VERBATIM ACCEPTANCE TEST (tests/board/cards.sh) ---
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# board-cards.sh parses the real tracker JSON shape, maps labels to columns, tokenizes idea as B,
# emits a git card per repo, keeps same-numbered issues in different repos distinct, sanitizes a
# tab in a title, and renders a failed tracker source as a single failed card.
set -uo pipefail
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
REPO="$(cd "$HERE/../.." && pwd)"
fail() { echo "FAIL: $1" >&2; exit 1; }
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmp/repoA" "$tmp/repoB" "$tmp/repoFail"        # real dirs so the stub's `cd` succeeds

# Stub tracker: emits the gh-shaped JSON array board-cards.sh must parse (cf. tracker.sh do_list).
stub="$tmp/tracker-stub.sh"
cat > "$stub" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
case "$PWD" in
  *repoA) printf '[{"number":52,"title":"Board\tMVP","labels":[{"name":"agent:working"}],"updatedAt":"2026-09-01T00:00:00Z"},{"number":7,"title":"An idea","labels":[{"name":"idea"}],"updatedAt":"2026-09-01T00:00:00Z"}]\n' ;;
  *repoB) printf '[{"number":52,"title":"Other repo issue","labels":[{"name":"agent:todo"}],"updatedAt":"2026-09-01T00:00:00Z"}]\n' ;;
  *repoFail) exit 4 ;;
esac
EOF
chmod +x "$stub"

now="$(date +%s)"
# Discovery TSV rows: path key root conf incl epoch unc ahead behind
disc() { printf '%s\t%s\tcreate\tyes\tyes\t%s\t%s\t%s\t\n' "$1" "$2" "$now" "$3" "$4"; }
{
  disc "$tmp/repoA" "create/repoA" 2 0
  disc "$tmp/repoB" "create/repoB" 0 0
  disc "$tmp/repoFail" "create/repoFail" 0 0
} > "$tmp/discovery.tsv"

out="$(TRACKER_CMD="$stub" bash "$REPO/scripts/board-cards.sh" < "$tmp/discovery.tsv")" || fail "cards exited non-zero"

col() { awk -F'\t' -v id="$1" '$1==id{print $4}' <<<"$out"; }
tok() { awk -F'\t' -v id="$1" '$1==id{print $6}' <<<"$out"; }
[ "$(col 'create/repoA#I52')" = in-session ] || fail "agent:working should map to in-session"
[ "$(col 'create/repoA#B7')" = backlog ] || fail "idea label should map to backlog with a B token"
[ "$(tok 'create/repoA#B7')" = B7 ] || fail "idea issue should carry a B token"
[ "$(col 'create/repoB#I52')" = next-up ] || fail "agent:todo should map to next-up"
[ -n "$(col 'create/repoA#I52')" ] && [ -n "$(col 'create/repoB#I52')" ] || fail "same-number issues merged across repos"
[ "$(col 'create/repoA#git')" = next-up ] || fail "git card missing or wrong column"
awk -F'\t' '$1=="create/repoA#git" && $9 ~ /uncommitted/{ok=1} END{exit ok?0:3}' <<<"$out" || fail "git position not composed"
awk -F'\t' '$5 ~ /\t/{exit 3}' <<<"$out" || fail "a tab survived into a title field"   # sanitization
[ "$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="create/repoFail#tracker"{print $11}' <<<"$out")" = failed ] || fail "failed tracker source not a failed card"
[ "$(grep -c 'create/repoFail' <<<"$out")" -eq 1 ] || fail "failed source must be exactly one card, never zero or many"
awk -F'\t' 'NF!=12{exit 3}' <<<"$out" || fail "a row does not have 12 fields"
echo "PASS: json parse, columns, B token, negative join, git card, sanitized title, failed source, 12 fields"
